name: Thorns that nudge the player back
body: A `thorns` kind from Chapter 3: touching it pushes the player back to the last ground position instead of failing the level. No health bar: the design says the player should never feel punished.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.
Built in slice 2: `thorns` pieces appear from their `min_chapter` and send the player back to the last safe spot on the ground, keeping gems. Test: engine/tests/host/thorns-nudge-the-player-back.
